resources.string: Choose a server on your network, then sign in with your Home Assistant account. No need to create or copy an access token.
The HA sign-in page will open in your headset browser. Sign in, then return to HomePanel MR; the app keeps and renews your session.
Waiting for browser sign-in… This session is valid for 5 minutes.
Sign-in received. Connecting to Home Assistant.
Stay signed in on this headset (encrypted)
Your sign-in request has been processed. Reopen HomePanel MR to check the connection.
Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.
The sign-in session timed out. Select sign-in to start again.
Unable to open the browser. Check the headset browser and try again.
Sign-in could not be completed. Check the connection to HA and its HTTPS certificate, then try again.
The server returned an invalid sign-in response. Please try again.
Your session has expired or been revoked. Sign in to Home Assistant again.
Unable to open the saved session. Sign in to Home Assistant again.
Unable to renew the session · retrying
This HA server uses unencrypted HTTP. Only sign in on a trusted private network; HTTPS certificates are validated.

Enable hand tracking in Quest settings and put your controllers down.

Point at a button and pinch your thumb and index finger to select it, or touch a nearby panel directly. Pinch and drag to scroll. Use + / − to adjust temperature, brightness or speed.

In Explore, face a saved device briefly to show its small action icons. Press an icon to control it. Look away to hide the icons; they stay visible while you point or touch. The three dots open details. Looking alone sends no command.

When placing a device, pinch away from the control panel to freeze the frame, or choose Freeze after 3 seconds and turn toward the object. Check the frame before saving. Device list and Return to window buttons are available on the panels.
Raise your hands into view; check hand tracking settings if needed.
Turn your head toward the object, raise either hand and pinch your thumb and index finger to freeze the frame. Avoid pointing at the panel while doing this. Then confirm here.
Face the device briefly for action icons. Press an icon to control it; look away to hide. The three dots open details.
Turn toward the object · %1$d s remaining
A familiar home. A new way to reach it.
Open a device and choose Place in room. Aim the frame at the real object, adjust its size, then save.
Connect Home Assistant to load your devices, or explore a demo room first.
This device has a saved location. Placing it again replaces the old location.
Place once, then look toward the marker on the object to open its controls.
This device has no entities to display or control.
HA has no target temperature yet. Adjust the value to set one.
Status only · no supported controls for this function.
IP scan checks port 8123 on up to 254 nearby addresses. Servers on another VLAN or a custom port may need manual entry.
Short IPs and hostnames use http:// and port 8123. Full URLs keep your port and HTTPS settings.
Create a long-lived access token in your Home Assistant profile. It is sent only when you select Connect.
The frame is fixed. Check that it surrounds the real object before saving.
If the object is not on a scanned surface, turn snapping off and adjust the distance.
Face a saved device to show its action icons. Look away to hide them. The small menu icon opens the device list.
Room loaded · ready to place devices
No room map loaded. Tap Set up room to scan, or Reload room if you already finished setup.
Room scan was not completed. You can try again.
Allow spatial data to save a placement. Tap Set up room to grant access.
Choose a device function before placing it.
The room changed. Aim again to choose a new position.
This device is no longer in HA. Place it again.
Room placement requires a Quest headset. HA controls are available in this window.
Aim this frame at the object. Adjust distance and size, then pinch or freeze after 3 seconds.
No scanned surface ahead, so the frame floats at the manual distance.
You place the frame manually; it does not detect or track moving objects.
Demo · no connection to your home
Check the Home Assistant address and network.
Cannot connect to HA. Check its address and network.
Enter an access token on this device.
This device does not support this action or value.
HA received the command. Displayed state is updated from HA.
Command not confirmed. Check the device before retrying.
Cannot read saved placements. Existing data has not been overwritten.
Cannot change damaged placement data. Restore it before continuing.
Cannot save placement. Please try again.
Device registry unavailable; showing individual entities.
Searching for Home Assistant on your network…
No HA found on this network. Check that the headset is on the same Wi-Fi, or enter an address.
Servers found. Choose your Home Assistant to connect.
Cannot discover servers on this network. You can enter an address.
No private IPv4 Wi-Fi/Ethernet network to scan. Try automatic discovery or enter an address.
%1$d placements do not match this room. Open the device list to place them again.
Saved: %1$s. Look toward its marker to open the controls.
Room data did not respond. Tap Reload room to try again.
Complete room setup in Quest, then return here.
Choose a room, then a device. Your saved placements stay linked to the real room.
Offline · showing the last known state
Select All devices to see configuration, diagnostics and other functions. Your Home Assistant data and saved placements are kept.
No everyday devices match. Try All devices for configuration and diagnostics.
We could not verify your copy.
Use the Meta account that purchased HomePanel MR or has access to its test channel, then try again.

An independent mixed reality client for Home Assistant. A working Home Assistant server and compatible devices are required for real device control. Demo mode uses sample devices. HomePanel MR is not affiliated with the Open Home Foundation or Meta.
You are exploring a demo home. Nothing here controls real devices.
The frame could not be frozen because the room map is not ready. Aim again or reload the room.
Not found in this room scan
Kept %1$d placements from your previous server address.
Aim at a button and pinch thumb and index finger to select. Pinch and drag to scroll, or touch a nearby panel.
Face a placed device briefly to show its action icons. Looking alone never sends a command.
Turn toward the object and pinch away from the panel to freeze the frame, or use the 3-second timer.
Turn on hand tracking in Quest settings and put your controllers down.
Place %1$s in your room to control it with a look and a pinch.
Sign in with your Home Assistant account

Try the panels and room placement with sample devices. No account needed.
Your sign-in stays encrypted on this headset. HomePanel MR talks only to your Home Assistant.
